summary:
輝達營收與獲利雙雙超越預期，AI 需求持續強勁帶動資料中心業務高速成長，但成長率預期趨緩。
• 資料中心營收年增 427% 至 226 億美元，顯示 AI 晶片需求持續旺盛。
• 總體營收年增 85% 至 81.61 億美元，顯示公司整體業務的強勁擴張。
• 獲利能力持續提升，毛利率達 78.9%，顯示其在 AI 晶片市場的定價能力。
• 公司宣布股票分割計畫，預計將於 6 月 7 日生效，以提高股票流動性。
ai_view:
訊號：強勁的 AI 需求持續推動輝達營收與獲利成長，資料中心業務表現亮眼。然而，市場已充分反映此利多，加上成長預期趨緩，股價短期內可能面臨整理壓力。中期來看，若能持續擴大市佔並推出革命性新產品，仍具成長潛力。追蹤指標：資料中心營收成長率、新一代 AI 晶片 H100 的出貨狀況、以及競爭對手的產品進展。

需留意：下一季營收成長預期放緩至 170% 左右，顯示成長動能可能趨於平穩。；地緣政治風險及供應鏈問題可能影響未來產能與出貨。

summary_en:
NVIDIA beat revenue and earnings estimates, driven by strong AI demand in its data center segment, though growth rate expectations are moderating.
• Data center revenue surged 427% year-over-year to $22.6 billion, underscoring robust demand for AI chips.
• Total revenue grew 85% year-over-year to $8.161 billion, indicating strong overall business expansion.
• Profitability remains high with a gross margin of 78.9%, reflecting strong pricing power in the AI chip market.
• Announced a stock split plan, effective June 7, to enhance stock liquidity.

ai_view_en:
Signal: Strong AI demand continues to drive NVIDIA's revenue and earnings growth, with the data center segment performing exceptionally well. However, the market may have already priced in these positives, and with moderating growth expectations, the stock could face consolidation pressure in the near term. Medium-term prospects depend on continued market share expansion and the introduction of revolutionary new products. Track: Data center revenue growth rate, shipment status of next-gen AI chips like H100, and competitor product advancements.

Watch：Next quarter's revenue growth forecast moderated to around 170%, suggesting a potential slowdown in growth momentum.; Geopolitical risks and supply chain issues could impact future production and shipments.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，營收與獲利均優於市場預期，主要受惠於強勁的 AI 需求。
